title: W8178629 — Diagnostic test mode entry
description: Less Dry pre-check and Diagnostic Test activation (§6-1 / §6-2). Beeps on each input change.

source.manualTitle: Maytag Centennial Electric & Gas Dryers (Job Aid ML-4)

steps.title: Fully assembled dryer
steps.body: Empty dryer, clean lint screen, connected to known good power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Begin with a fully assembled, empty dryer with clean lint screen.

steps.title: Less Dry test (§6-1)
steps.body: Door closed, Timer Less Dry, Temperature High, End of Cycle Signal Louder. Press Push to Start — timer should advance to Off in ~16 seconds. If not, proceed to Diagnostic Test entry.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Timer will start to advance to the Off position after approximately 16 seconds.

steps.title: Diagnostic Test entry (§6-2)
steps.body: Door open, Temperature Air Fluff, Signal Louder, Timer Timed or Sensor Drying. Turn Wrinkle Prevent Off→On three times within 5 seconds. Single beep, pause, single beep = test mode active. Each input change beeps (door, moisture sensor, temp, wrinkle, PTS, timer).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Wrinkle Prevent switch from Off to On three times within a five second period.
